name: Reinvented Self
description: Burned the old self to the ground and built something new
behavioral_signature: Aggressively rejects their past identity and maintains the new one
under_stress: The old self bleeds through the cracks
at_rest: Confident in who they've become, avoids who they were
will_never: acknowledge the person they used to be
unless: someone from the old life forces a reckoning
